meta.title: SOLTERRA — Vietnam Green Coffee Supplier Rooted in Gia Lai
meta.description: Solterra is a Vietnam green coffee supplier rooted in Gia Lai and Tay Nguyen, supplying Robusta, Arabica, specialty lots and commercial grade green coffee for export buyers.

hero.eyebrow: Gia Lai Origin · Tay Nguyen Supply Base
hero.title: Robusta Strength From Vietnam's Tay Nguyen Highlands
hero.subtitle: Gia Lai's red soil, highland climate and mature harvest seasons create a bold, intense Vietnamese coffee character. As an origin-based supplier, Solterra provides stable, trusted and verifiable green coffee lots for roasters and importers.

advantages.title: Rooted in Gia Lai, Supplying Vietnam Tay Nguyen Coffee

items.title: Gia Lai Origin Base
items.body: We grew up in Gia Lai and understand the relationship between Tay Nguyen red soil, seasons and Robusta raw material quality.

items.title: Trusted Lot Control
items.body: Each lot is confirmed around moisture, screen size, defect rate and packing requirements so buyers can verify what they buy.

items.title: Stable Supply Capacity
items.body: With Gia Lai and surrounding Tay Nguyen areas as our supply base, we support recurring supply, long-term contracts and stable planning.

items.title: Supplier Responsibility
items.body: From lot confirmation and export packing to delivery coordination, Solterra works as the accountable supplier for every cooperation.

products.title: Green Coffee Catalog From Gia Lai and Tay Nguyen
products.subtitle: More than origin names. Each category is built around real supply capacity, lot standards and practical B2B purchasing needs.

robusta-green.name: Gia Lai Robusta Green Coffee
robusta-green.body: A core Robusta supply from Vietnam's Tay Nguyen highlands, bold in character and suitable for roasters, instant coffee, espresso blends and volume purchasing.

arabica-green.name: Vietnam Arabica Green Coffee
arabica-green.body: Configured for buyers who need brighter flavor and finer layers. A useful complement to Tay Nguyen Robusta for specialty roasters, chains and premium blends.

specValues.origin: Lam Dong, Son La, Dien Bien
specValues.useCase: Single origin / Specialty blend / Coffee chains

specialty-lots.name: Tay Nguyen Specialty Lots
specialty-lots.body: Small, cuppable and traceable lots for roasters who want to explore the highland character of Vietnam beyond commodity coffee.

commercial-grade.name: Commercial Grade Green Coffee
commercial-grade.body: Designed for volume purchasing and stable recipes, with emphasis on consistent supply, baseline quality and reliable delivery rhythm.

organic-sustainable.name: Organic and Sustainable Lots
organic-sustainable.body: For buyers who need origin storytelling, sustainability positioning or specific certification documents. Certification and traceability are confirmed by actual lot.

custom-sourcing.name: Contract Supply Program
custom-sourcing.body: Buyers share target price, flavor, monthly volume, process, screen size and packing requirements. Solterra configures suitable lots from Gia Lai and Tay Nguyen and arranges sample confirmation.

specValues.serviceScope: Lot configuration / Samples / Quality data / Export coordination

process.title: Supply Process
process.subtitle: From harvest to packing, each step is controlled and traceable.

steps.title: Harvest
steps.body: We select stable lots and record origin, farm area and harvest window.

steps.title: Processing
steps.body: Washed, honey or natural processing is selected according to the target flavor and lot requirement.

steps.title: Drying
steps.body: Moisture reduction is monitored to avoid moldy notes and over-fermentation.

steps.title: Grading
steps.body: Screen grading, moisture checks, defect sorting and cupping are arranged by lot.

steps.title: Packing
steps.body: Jute bags with GrainPro liners are prepared for export stability during long-distance transport.

sample.body: We provide 200–500g samples for cupping evaluation. Sample terms and shipping are confirmed before dispatch.
sample.note: Please share target category, expected volume and receiving address when requesting samples.
